wordlist_file.description: Path to dictionary/wordlist file for offline attack

hash_file.description: Path to precomputed hash file (output of genpmk); mutually exclusive with capture_file

capture_file.description: Path to .cap packet capture file; mutually exclusive with hash_file

ssid.description: Target WPA SSID; must match the ESSID in the capture or hash file

check_only.description: Only verify presence of valid 4-way handshake frames; do not perform dictionary attack

verbose_level.description: Verbosity level: 0 = quiet, 1 = standard verbose, 2 = more verbose, etc. (maps to -v flag repetition)
